import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Dataset with datetime column
data = {
    'timestamp': pd.date_range('2024-01-01', periods=20, freq='6h'),
    'value': np.random.randn(20).cumsum() + 100
}
df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Extract temporal components
df['year'] = df['timestamp'].dt.year
df['month'] = df['timestamp'].dt.month
df['day'] = df['timestamp'].dt.day
df['hour'] = df['timestamp'].dt.hour
df['dayofweek'] = df['timestamp'].dt.dayofweek

# Create is_weekend boolean feature
df['is_weekend'] = df['dayofweek'] >= 5

# Create is_business_hours feature
df['is_business_hours'] = (df['hour'] >= 9) & (df['hour'] < 17) & ~df['is_weekend']

# Create cyclical encoding for hour
df['hour_sin'] = np.sin(2 * np.pi * df['hour'] / 24)
df['hour_cos'] = np.cos(2 * np.pi * df['hour'] / 24)

# Print the dataframe with all extracted features
print(df[['timestamp', 'hour', 'dayofweek', 'is_weekend', 'is_business_hours', 'hour_sin', 'hour_cos']])
